plant.configure.function_zh: 宿主配置有限样品、热学、真实溶剂与可选测量误差假设

sample.load.function_zh: 人工装入有限胶体；数据条件迁移必须显式接受

sample.unload.function_zh: 取回未消耗的胶体与液体，热量和物质账本持续保留

cell.configure.function_zh: 人工更换石英池或Omega电位池；几何平移为选择代理非真实执行器

cuvette.set.function_zh: 打开外盖后人工取放光学池；运行和高温互锁

cell_cap.set.function_zh: 池外受检人工开合比色皿盖与堵头

lid.release.function_zh: 按OPEN释放外盖，按键0.2s后复位

lid.set.function_zh: 释放后向后翻盖；闭盖检查比色皿插入和封口

power.set.function_zh: 6分钟激光预热；断电取消采集、停止激光与电场，样品继续被动换热

purge.fill.function_zh: 宿主加入有限干燥N2储量

purge.set.function_zh: 低于露点时启用2L/min干燥N2吹扫；有限耗气

method.configure.function_zh: DLS三角或15度ELS，独立输入溶剂及温度参数

temperature.calibrate.function_zh: 输入独立外部两点温度标准，禁止读取真值自校准

dls.calibrate.function_zh: 保存独立标准与观测的粒径比例校正；示例为工程输入

mobility.calibrate.function_zh: 外部迁移率两点标定，作用于相位反演结果

acquisition.start.function_zh: 温度平衡后按时间采集相关函数或正反电场相位

acquisition.stop.function_zh: 取消保留采集和物质/能量；立即撤电场及测量激光

process.measure.function_zh: 纯读g2、非负反演强度PSD、PDI、迁移率与ζ及来源

ledger.read.function_zh: 有限液体/粒子/N2和两节点热量守恒

template.reference.function_zh: 真实材料原始统计量/曲线证据查询

accessory.ultralowvolume.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

accessory.univette.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

analysis.cmpals_oem.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

analysis.maps.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

analysis.mie_number_concentration.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

analysis.sls_molar_mass.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

fault.probability_model.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

hardware.connect.function_zh: 范围外功能，明确unsupported不输出伪读数

light_scattering.meaning_zh: 有限胶体、热学、真实DLS相关曲线/统计量输入与电泳相位反演
equations: Raw measured g2 retains original tau and all acquisition columns. Accepted cross-condition transfer rescales tau by (T/eta)/(Tref/etaref)*(q/qref)² with unchanged intensity weights
Scalar-only CAD records: assumed gamma distribution of decay rates gives g1=(1+PDI*Gamma_mean*tau)^(-1/PDI); g2=1+beta*g1²; this is constructed, not measured raw signal

Output size/PDI fitted from measured-or-modeled g2, never copied from reference scalar; independent NNLS inverse Laplace with second-difference regularization gives intensity weights over0.3nm–15µm; number distribution unsupported

Electrophoresis mu=2*epsilon0*epsilon_r*zeta*f_H/(3*eta); phase±=q*(±mu*E+v_EOF)*t+phase0; wrapped phase unwrapped, opposite fitted slopes remove constant EOF; mu_measured=(slope_plus-slope_minus)/(2*q_entered*E); zeta_reported=3*eta_entered*mu_cal/(2*epsilon_entered*f_entered)

Finite heat Cblock*dTb=Qpeltier+Gambient*(Tamb-Tb)-Gsample*(Tb-Ts); Csample*dTs=Gsample*(Tb-Ts)+laser_absorption+sigma*E²*Vactive; Qpeltier bounded independently, manufacturer50W not assumed heating power
Liquid/particles loaded=present+returned; measurement nondestructive; N2 added=stock+exhaust; purge2L/min converted at ambient n=PV/RT
External two-point temperature/mobility calibration and scalar DLS size factor are independent inputs. True viscosity/refractive index/permittivity and entered values are separated
Output source and evidence survive unload; host-authenticated private truth, request idempotence, owned async operations, failed call atomic rollback; pure reads never advance time
